verdict.rationale: Raygun does have an official MCP server (raygun-probe-3) and docs describe rich stack-trace/error data (raygun-docs-1) plus a triage workflow via error statuses (raygun-docs-25, raygun-docs-10) and repo integrations (raygun-docs-2), but there is no evidence of an actual 'file bug into external tracker' action via API/MCP, and the lack of a public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (raygun-probe-1, raygun-probe-2) undercuts confidence in a full agent-friendly API surface. missing for 10: evidence of automated ticket creation in external trackers via API/MCP, a documented OpenAPI/agent-facing API spec, and hands-on proof the MCP server can retrieve top production issues end-to-end.
